78182.backText: Put the set aside First Among Many and Tendrils of the First into play at Independence Square.
78182.backFlavor:
A crash comes from ground level, followed by a multitude of screams.
The First Among Many quickly writhes into the space of Independence Square. Though little of it resembles a human form, a face is visible in the mound of flesh. The twisted face looks at the building above, and screams a single word.
“WEST!”

78183.name: It Just Won’t Die
78183.text:
Forced – When a Ritual story asset would enter a player’s discard pile or be removed from the game: Attach that asset to the Observation Deck.
(Beware — Any investigator on First Among Many’s floor when the agenda advances will be killed.)
78183.flavor: The First Among Many begins to subsume the town hall floor by floor, pursuing its prey. You better make sure that doesn’t include you.
78183.backText:
Each investigator on a location with a Floor trait matching the First Among Many’s location is killed.
Remove each location with a Floor trait matching the First Among Many’s current location from the game, then move the First Among Many to a location with a Floor trait one greater than the removed locations. Attach any Ritual assets attached to those locations to the Observation Deck location, and discard any other attachments or enemies at the removed locations. If Tendrils of the First is discarded this way, place it in the victory display.
If the First is on a Floor 4 location, and the Rusted Blade and Killing Words are not in the victory display, (→R2).
If the First is on a Floor 5 location, advance to agenda 3a.
Flip this agenda back to agenda 2a.
78183.backFlavor: The First grows and expands. Within moments, an entire floor is completely uninhabitable.

78184.name: Final Breath
78184.text: Forced – When a Ritual story asset would enter a player’s discard pile or be removed from the game: Attach that asset to the Observation Deck.
78184.flavor: The tower creaks and groans as it sways in the wind. The mass of flesh has devoured all but the ritual site. It’s now or never.
78184.backFlavor: You rush to complete the ritual, but your enemy catches you unaware. Within moments, you are dragged backwards, into the walls of flesh…

78185.name: Know the Unknowable
78185.flavor: Any way to destroy the First is beyond your grasp. For now, all you can do is hold it off.
78185.backFlavor:
You run into West ascending a staircase. “You! We don’t have much time. The Tailors managed to gather the components to my specifications. But you know their type, incapable of doing anything right. The components are scattered throughout the tower. I’ve been trying to corral them, but with this creature… they’ve lost all logic. Barely better than panicked animals.
Which means it’s down to us. There were a number of useful components, but only three are crucial - the binding runes, which when correctly placed can trap the soul in a moment in time. An ancestral blade of the target, to bring it to heel. And a book, containing a phrase we need to kill this creature. You get them prepared and meet me on the roof. Anything else you find should prove useful, but don’t waste too much time!”

78186.name: Fight the Unfightable
78186.text:
Each location that has not been “ransacked” gains: “[free] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card of the Ritual deck and attach it to this location. Remember that you have “ransacked” this location.”
Objective – If the following cards are in the victory display, advance:
– Rusted Blade
– Killing Words
– Binding Runes
78186.flavor: The Tailors try to make the last of their ritual preparations, but minutes remain. You’ll have to do their jobs for them.
78186.backText:
Floor 0.
Revelation – Place Pickman’s Memory in the victory display, and attach each asset in the victory display to it. Spawn the set-aside Dr. Elias Pickman enemy at Pickman’s Memory.
Each enemy and investigator in the victory display is considered to be at Pickman’s Memory.
Victory 1.
78186.backFlavor: A final moment, trapped in time.

78187.name: Kill the Unkillable
78187.text:
Investigators, locations, and enemies in the victory display are still in play.
Forced – When an enemy in the victory display would be defeated by damage: Instead, exhaust that enemy and heal 1 damage from it.
Objective – When Dr. Elias Pickman is defeated, advance. (Cards in play with victory points will be counted whether or not they are in the victory display.)
78187.flavor: The ritual is ready. If you enter a place beyond existence and eliminate the soul inside of the creature, you can destroy it, once and for all.
78187.backFlavor:
You speak the words. They tear at your very soul, thrashing in your sway like a wild animal. But you hold strong, and they strike true.
Pickman drops to his knees. As he gasps for air, a wound, like a rifle shot, appears on his chest. He frantically tears at the opening, as if trying to comprehend what is happening. With a terrible choking noise, he falls dead.
The memory begins to spin.

78188.name: Independence Square
78188.text: You cannot trigger [action], [free], or [reaction] abilities at Independence Square.
78188.flavor: A sense of impending doom hangs over the park.
78188.backFlavor: Independence Square, at the base of Town Hall, is completely abandoned.

78189.name: Campaign Office
78189.text: [action]: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and draw it. If you drew a weakness this way, gain 3 resources. Shuffle your deck.
78189.flavor:
“Own your flaws, and nothing can touch you!”
What a stupid poster.
78189.backFlavor:
“Atkinson: Keeping Arkham Safe!”
They might want to change that slogan.

78190.name: Office Lobby
78190.text: Enemies at this location get –1 fight and –1 evade.
78190.flavor: That perfect combination of open space and obstacles that makes for an ideal firefight. Pity the previous human inhabitants lost theirs.
78190.backFlavor: Blood splatters and shell casings. The Arkham mayoral staff have had a difficult day.

78191.name: Makeshift Lab
78191.text: [action]: Look at the top card of the Ritual Deck. You may spend 2 resources to place it on the bottom of the Ritual deck. If you control the Suspicious Briefcase asset, you may take an additional action. This does not count towards the number of actions you may take this turn.
78191.flavor: The plans for the ritual are scattered amongst the clutter.
78191.backFlavor: What was once a kitchen has been rapidly arranged to work as an experimental station. The Tailors have been busy.

78192.name: Organizer’s Office
78192.text: [action]: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. If a Terror card is among the looked at cards, take 1 horror. You may place these cards on the top or bottom of the encounter deck in any order. (Group limit once per round.)
78192.flavor: The large window makes for a great view of your impending doom.
78192.backFlavor: You’d call this office immaculately kept, except for the fine layer of dust on top of all the orderly papers.

78193.name: Observatory
78193.text:
While you are at the Observatory, play with the top card of your deck revealed.
[free] If there are no clues on this location and Killing Words is attached to this location: Place Killing Words in the victory display.
78193.backFlavor: A previous mayor installed a massive viewing telescope into Town Hall “so that Arkham will always remember it has friends in the stars.”

78194.name: Tinkerer’s Workshop
78194.text:
[action] Spend X resources. X is the resource cost of an Item asset in your discard pile: Add that asset to your hand.
[free] If there are no clues on this location and Rusted Blade is attached to this location: Place Rusted Blade in the victory display.
78194.flavor: With enough money and time, you could fix anything here.
78194.backFlavor: The engineer in charge of public works turned most of the third floor into her personal workshop.

78195.name: Clock Chamber North
78195.text:
Forced – After you reveal Clock Chamber North: Reveal Clock Chamber South.
[action]: Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, trigger the Forced effect on Clock Chamber South as if it were the end of the round.
Victory 1.
78195.flavor: The core of the mechanism. Perhaps you could make some use of it?
78195.backFlavor: An inscrutable engine of gears and pistons sits at the heart of the clock tower.

78196.name: Clock Chamber South
78196.text:
Forced – At the end of the round: Deal 1 damage to each investigator and enemy at Clock Chamber South. Place 1 clue on Clock Chamber South.
[action]: You stall the mechanism. Test [combat] (1). For each point you succeed by, reduce the shroud of Clock Chamber North by 1 for the remainder of the round.
78196.flavor: The winding gears form a very gradual deathtrap.
78196.backFlavor: From a distance, you can see the many shifting gears and pistons. Seems dangerous.

78197.name: Observation Deck
78197.text:
Forced – When you trigger the [free] ability on Act 2: Instead of remembering that you have “ransacked” the Observation Deck, place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Observation Deck.
[free] If there are no clues on this location and Binding Runes is attached to this location: Place Binding Runes in the victory display.
78197.flavor: The howling wind drowns out the howling flesh below.
78197.backFlavor: The fading rays illuminate a beautiful view of the surviving city. In this place of serenity, the surviving Tailors prepare to enter the memories of the First’s soul.

78198.name: Binding Runes
78198.text:
[reaction] When an enemy at your location would ready, take 1 direct damage: That enemy does not ready.
[action]: Take control of Binding Runes or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at Binding Runes’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)
Victory 0.

78199.name: Blessing of Tomorrow
78199.text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [action] abilities.
[action]: Take control of Blessing of Tomorrow or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at Blessing of Tomorrow’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)

78200.name: EX.O.L
78200.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +4 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +4 damage.
[action]: Take control of EX.O.L or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at EX.O.L’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)

78201.name: Hedge Mage’s Bag
78201.text:
You have 2 additional hand slots.
[action]: Take control of Hedge Mage’s Bag or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at Hedge Mage’s Bag’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)
78201.flavor: Built for holding all manner of oddities.

78202.name: Killing Words
78202.text:
[action] Take direct horror equal to an enemy’s remaining health at your location: Parley. Defeat that enemy.
[action]: Take control of Killing Words or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at Killing Words’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)
Victory 0.

78203.name: Rusted Blade
78203.text:
[action]: Fight. You may use any skill (including [combat]) for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
[action]: Take control of Rusted Blade or attach it to your current location. Any investigator at Rusted Blade’s location may activate this ability. (Group limit once per round.)
Victory 0.

78204.name: First Among Many
78204.text:
Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot be attacked or evaded.
First Among Many’s location gains the Miasma trait and is connected to the victory display (as if it were a location) while the Tendrils of the First is moving.
78204.flavor: It howls West’s name over and over.

78205.name: Tendrils of the First
78205.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
Tendrils of the First cannot make attacks of opportunity.
While Tendrils of the First is in the victory display, it is still considered to be in play.
Victory 2.

78206.name: Dr. Elias Pickman
78206.text:
Dr. Elias Pickman gets +X health, where X is the number of clues on Pickman’s Memory.
Dr. Elias Pickman cannot be defeated by damage.
Forced – When Elias Pickman would take any amount of damage from a source other than Rusted Blade: Reduce that damage to 1.
78206.flavor: “You will not stop me. You cannot stop me.”

78207.name: Come Crashing Down
78207.text: Revelation – Test [agility] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the number of the Floor of your location (Floor 1 is 1, Floor 2 is 2…). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 resource or choose and discard 1 card.
78207.flavor: It’s a long way to the bottom.

78208.name: It’s You or Me.
78208.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Choose an investigator. That investigator must move directly to the First Among Many’s location.

78209.name: Seeking Stalks
78209.text:
Revelation –Test [agility] (3). If you fail, put Seeking Stalks into play in your threat area.
Forced – After you move: Resolve the Hunter keyword on Tendrils of the First.
[action][action]: Discard Seeking Stalks. If you control a Melee asset, you may take an additional action. This does not count towards the number of actions you may take this turn.

78210.name: Shrieking Affliction
78210.text: Revelation – Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each of your hand slots that is filled. For each point you fail by, take 1 horror, to a maximum of 3 horror.
78210.flavor: A pitch that threatens to shatter your mind.

78211.name: Undying Hatred
78211.text: Revelation – You must either ready Tendrils of the First and move it directly to your location, or place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

78212.name: Writhing Closer
78212.text:
Surge.
Revelation – If Tendrils of the First is engaged with at least 1 investigator, it attacks each engaged investigator. Otherwise, move it 1 location towards the nearest investigator.

78213.name: The Midnight Hour
78213.text:
[skull]: –X. X is the number of locations with a horror on them. (Max 4.)
[cultist]: –4. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to any enemy in play or discover 1 clue from any location in play.
[tablet]: –4. If you fail, move once towards the nearest Miasma location.
[elder_thing]: –3. If you fail, each investigator who has Heeded the Call must resolve a Forced ability on a Miasma location as if they had started their turn there.
78213.backText:
[skull]: –X. X is the number of locations with a horror on them.
[cultist]: –6. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to any enemy in play or discover 1 clue from any location in play.
[tablet]: –4. After this test ends, move once towards the nearest Miasma location.
[elder_thing]: –3. If you fail, each investigator who has Heeded the Call must resolve the Forced ability on each Miasma location as if they had started their turn there.

78214.name: The Plaguebearer Unbound
78214.text:
Baalshandor gains Hunter and Massive.
Do not remove doom from this agenda when it advances.
Forced – After Baalshandor leaves play: Advance this agenda.
78214.flavor: The worst has come to pass. Baalshandor walks the streets of Arkham, seeking your death.
78214.backText:
Set Baalshandor aside, out of play. Move all doom from Agenda 1a to Agenda 2a. Shuffle the set-aside copies of Growing Destruction, One of Many, and Fear the Writhing Life into the encounter deck.
Check Campaign Log. For each location marked as Infected, flip it over. If a location is recorded as Flame-Touched, place the set-aside Messenger of Flame asset at that location. If a location is recorded as Madness-Touched, place the set-aside Messenger of the King asset at that location.
Advance to Act 1b.
78214.backFlavor:
Death?
You think you threaten me with death?
Bear witness to my demise.

The being that is Baalshandor explodes outwards in a tide of flesh.

Death is my dominion. In death, I only grow.
Your weapons, your magics - they mean nothing to me.
Now it is my turn to bear witness.

Throughout the city, you hear a cacophony of destruction as entire buildings, suddenly overtaken with flesh, tear themselves free…

78215.name: Arkham Infected
78215.text:
Locations with horror on them cannot be flipped or make attacks of opportunity.
Forced – At the end of the round, for each investigator at a non-Miasma location with no horror on it: You must either flip the nearest Stable location, or place 1 doom on the nearest Miasma enemy with no horror on it.
78215.flavor: In death, the Plaguebearer has only grown. The entire city is becoming part of Baalshandor. What chance do you stand against a monster the size of Arkham?
78215.backText:
Shuffle the set-aside Unbound Power encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Check Campaign Log. If a location is recorded as the Site of Unbinding, the lead investigator draws the set-aside Flesh Unbound encounter card.
78215.backFlavor:
I live, I die. I only grow.
Resistance is useless. Yours, and others.
Unbound, my power has no equal.

78216.name: Monstrous City
78216.text:
Locations with horror on them cannot be flipped or make attacks of opportunity.
Forced – At the end of the round, for each investigator at a non-Miasma location with no horror on it: You must either flip the nearest Stable location, or place 1 doom on the nearest Miasma enemy with no horror on it.
78216.flavor:
With each passing moment, I grow more powerful.
Heed the Call.
My flesh will be your end.
78216.backText:
If it is not Act 4:
I transcend.
I evolve.
I bring my gifts to all the creatures on this wretched world.

Heed the call.
(→R1)
If it is Act 4:
Bound?
Again?
Then I will claim you.
(→R2)

78217.name: Death of the Plaguebearer
78217.text:
Baalshandor’s location gains the Miasma trait and: “[fast]: Parley. Investigate. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to Baalshandor.”
Objective – Defeat Baalshandor.
78217.flavor: It all comes down to this. Destroy Baalshandor and end his rein of pestilence.
78217.backText:
Check Campaign Log. If an investigator controls Suspicious Briefcase and the investigators “received a cryptic riddle”:
You cannot kill Baalshandor. Death and life are the same to the Plaguebearer.
But with strange aeons, even death may die.
Proceed to Act 2a: The Reagent.
Otherwise, if an investigator controls Herbert West:
“I have a theory. If death is a necessary form of this creature’s life cycle… what if we could trap it in an undying state?”
Proceed to Act 2a: The Doctor.
Otherwise:
You have nothing. The Plaguebearer is everywhere and only growing. But if you can give him no quarter, nowhere to spread…
Proceed to Act 3a: Stunt the Growth.

78218.name: The Reagent
78218.text:
[reaction] When a Miasma location would flip, if an investigator at that location controls Suspicious Briefcase, you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues as a group: Place 1 horror on that location.
Objective – At the end of the round, if each location has a horror on it, advance.
Objective – This isn’t working. At the end of the round, the investigators may advance.
78218.flavor: Baalshandor may have dominion over death. But if you could sever that connection using the re-animation reagent…
78218.backText:
If each location has a horror on it:
The creatures that Arkham has become thrash about madly, then grow still. You tentatively inch closer, then grab a tendril. You can feel the pulse of the monster, but it no longer moves.
Your heart catches in your throat. Did it work?
You shake yourself, and find that you are standing before the form of Baalshandor.
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?
Remember that “you have conquered death.” Advance to act 3b.
Otherwise:
A massive limb of flesh comes bearing down upon you. You trip as you dodge, and the briefcase goes sliding underneath the arm’s path. You cry out as you hear the telltale crunching of glass.
If Suspicious Briefcase is in any play area, remove it from the game. Advance to act 3a.

78219.name: The Doctor
78219.text:
[reaction] When a Miasma location would flip, if an investigator at that location controls Herbert West, you may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues as a group: Place 1 horror on that location.
Objective – At the end of the round, if each location has a horror on it, advance.
Objective – West’s plan is folly. At the end of the round, the investigators may advance.
78219.flavor: “We can stop this – You just have to trust me.” Herbert says. What choice do you have?
78219.backText:
If each location has a horror on it:
The creatures that Arkham has become thrash about madly, then grow still. “Death throes! It’s working!” West cackles with delight.
Your heart catches in your throat. Is Dr. West right?
You shake yourself from your thoughts, and find that you are standing before the form of Baalshandor. He holds West aloft before his jaws.
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?
“I am Herbert West. And I have conquered death.”
West is pulled into the god’s maw still grinning.
Remember that “Herbert West conquered death”. Move each investigator to Baalshandor’s location. Advance to act 3b.
Otherwise:
You hear a shout, and see West grappling with muscle and sinew growing from the ground to trap his limbs. Before you can react, they have covered the doctor altogether.
If Herbert West is in any play area, remove him from the game. Advance to act 3a.

78220.name: Stunt the Growth
78220.text:
[reaction] After you defeat and flip a Miasma enemy, if you “know of the binding”, the investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues as a group: Place 1 horror on the Stable location side of that enemy.
Objective – At the end of the round, if each location has a horror on it, advance.
78220.flavor: Fighting the Plaguebearer isn’t working. He’s only growing further. But if you can purify his strongholds in Arkham and find a way to bind him, you could at least bind him to the spot.
78220.backText:
Remove each location and story asset at those locations from the game. Discard each enemy that is removed this way.
Put the set aside Body of Baalshandor (Thrashing), Mind of Baalshandor (Scheming), and Soul of Baalshandor (Hating) into play. Move each investigator to the Soul of Baalshandor.
Put the set-aside Baalshandor enemy into play next to the act deck. For the remainder of the scenario, Baalshandor is considered to be in play but is not at any location.
78220.backFlavor:
The city falls silent. The world seems to fall away. All that exists is you and Baalshandor. He looms in your vision, the same shape as before, but thrice his previous impossible size.
ENOUGH. DIE.
In moments, you are swallowed whole.

78221.name: Life of the Plaguebearer
78221.text:
Forced – When you defeat a Miasma location enemy: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Baalshandor.
Forced – When a location enemy enters play: Heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from Baalshandor.
Objective – If Baalshandor is defeated, advance.
78221.flavor: The Plaguebearer is defeated, his plots foiled. It’s time to end this nightmare once and for all.
78221.backText:
If “you have conquered death”, (→R7).
If “Herbest West conquered death”, (→R8).
Otherwise, (→R3).
78221.backFlavor:
IMPOSSIBLE.
YOU CANNOT WIN!
YOU ARE NOTHING!
I AM… UNDONE…

78222.name: Arkham Advertiser
78222.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may return an event from their discard pile to their hand.
78222.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Exile the event in your hand with the highest experience cost.

78223.name: Bank of Arkham
78223.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may gain 2 resources.
78223.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Lose all your resources.

78224.name: General Store
78224.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may play an asset from their hand, reducing it’s resource cost by 1.
78224.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Choose a non-permanent asset you control. Discard each asset in your play area and hand with the same resource cost as the chosen asset.

78225.name: Hibb’s Roadhouse
78225.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may gets +1 to each of their skills until the end of the round.
78225.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: You automatically fail the next test you take this phase.

78226.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78226.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may return an Ally asset from their discard pile to their hand.
78226.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Move damage from this location onto a single Ally asset you control equal to that asset’s remaining health.

78227.name: Orne Library
78227.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may draw 2 cards.
78227.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Choose and discard all but 2 cards from your hand.

78228.name: River Docks
78228.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may return a skill card from their discard pile to their hand.
78228.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Discard each skill card in your hand.

78229.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78229.text: [reaction] After you flip to this side of this location: Each investigator at this location may return the highest cost asset in their discard pile to their hand.
78229.backText:
Miasma. Elite.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

78230.name: Arkham Advertiser
78230.text:
[reaction] After you play an event at this location: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78230.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may search their deck and discard pile for an event, and play it at no cost.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78230.backFlavor: “We’ve been piecing together the details of all of this - doing what research we can ever since you saved us.” Doyle motions to a desk plastered with back-issues and snippets of old articles. “It might sound batty, but everything that’s happened in the past day - it fits a pattern. You fit a pattern, too. A pattern that don’t always end good - but it don’t always end bad neither. And, if you’ll hear it, I think we have some ideas about how you might make it a happy ending.”

78231.name: Bank of Arkham
78231.text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate this location: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78231.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may gain 10 resources.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78231.backFlavor:
“Let me be perfectly clear. This gold I am entrusting you is not enchanted. We have kept it in the bank since its founding merely because its proper owner has never come to collect it. That the bank and the city have prospered despite the overwhelming odds that come with the instability of this region while it lay in our deepest vault is merely a coincidence.
Please do bring it back when this is all over.”

78232.name: General Store
78232.text:
[fast] Spend any number of resources: Search the top X cards of your deck for an asset and put it into play, where X is twice the number of resources you spent. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78232.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may return any number of assets in play to their hand. Each investigator may play any number of assets from their hand at no cost.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78232.backFlavor:
“While you were out, the oddest man dropped by. Thin, pointy little beard. Said he had something for you - this amulet. Said you’d need it when the time was right.” Davy looks out the window at the increasing carnage all over town.
“Now seems like the right time.”

78233.name: Hibb’s Roadhouse
78233.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more at this location: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from a card you control.(Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78233.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may heal 3 damage and 3 horror. If an investigator controls Hibbs, that investigator may instead heal all damage and horror from their investigator.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78233.backFlavor: A safe is dragged out from under the bar - dusty, and clearly decades old. Inside, beside a tattered deed, is a bottle of something vaguely luminescent. “Hibbs always joked he had some water from the fountain of youth. We always figured it was a sham, but what do you know? We took a vote and think you deserve it.”

78234.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78234.text:
[fast]: Search your deck for an Ally asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78234.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may search the collection for a level 0-3 Ally asset and put it into play under their control.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78234.backFlavor: “I know you think I’m a doddering old fool. But there is power in prayer. Miracles can occur.” Ma Matheson opens the door to reveal a face you never thought you’d see again. “The Lord works in mysterious ways, dearie.”

78235.name: Orne Library
78235.text:
[reaction] After the draw cards step of upkeep, if you have 5 or more cards in hand: Draw 1 card.
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78235.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may draw until they reach their maximum hand size. Shuffle any weaknesses drawn this way back into your deck.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78235.backFlavor: Armitage trembles as he hands you a sheet of parchment. “Against my better judgement, I’ve been reading through the Necronomicon Ex Mortis. I have found an invocation of power…. it will either grant you immense knowledge or it will kill someone on the spot. Frustratingly difficult to say. My capability with Aramaic is lacking, but I am confident this will do what you need. I trust you will destroy this translation once it is no longer needed - using it twice would have catastrophic results.”

78236.name: River Docks
78236.text:
[reaction] When you commit an eligible skill card to a skill test at this location: It gains [wild] and the text: “After this test ends, you may draw 1 card.” (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78236.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may search their deck and discard pile for up to 3 skill cards and add them to their hand.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78236.backFlavor: “Some time ago, the boys found one of the warehouses sorta empty. Filled with corpses and deathtraps. And… weirder stuff. We’ve kept it under lock and key, but figured you might know what to do with it.” Abner hefts a longbox filled to the brim with unspeakable implements. Just what you need to give you a boost - or destroy something completely.

78237.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78237.text:
[fast]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, search your deck for a Spell or Relic asset and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
While it is not act 1, this location gains: “[free] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues: Flip this location and resolve its story text.”
78237.backText:
The investigator who flipped this card chooses one:
– Each investigator may search the collection for a level 0-3 non-Ally asset and put it into play under their control.
– Flip any number of non-Rallied locations.
– Place a horror token on a location.
Flip this card over and place a horror token on it.
78237.backFlavor: Miriam’s form rises through the air, energy crackling between her hands and the ground. “Such a strange thing, our fragile forms. Yet the power we hold sway over… What is your wish, mortal? You need merely envision what you desire, and I will summon it from your world or the next.”

78238.name: Body of Baalshandor
78238.text: [fast]: Parley. Lose 1 resource. Move to the Soul of Baalshandor.
78238.backText:
Miasma.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: If you do not control a copy of Strength of Flesh, flip Body of Baalshandor.
78238.backFlavor:
No living flesh may betray my might.
Heed the call, puppet.

78239.name: Mind of Baalshandor
78239.text: [fast]: Parley. Choose and discard a card from your hand. Move to the Body of Baalshandor.
78239.backText:
Miasma.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: If you do not control a copy of Unbreakable Will, flip Mind of Baalshandor.
78239.backFlavor:
My mind is endless.
What mortal will can stand against me?

78240.name: Soul of Baalshandor
78240.text:
Retaliate. Alert.
[fast][fast]: Parley. Move to the Mind of Baalshandor.
78240.backText:
Miasma. Unbinding.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location, if there is another investigator at this location: Flip this location.
78240.backFlavor:
I am the darkness in each heart,
the stain upon each soul.
None dare fight the Plaguebearer.

78241.name: Crater of Unbinding
78241.text:
Crater of Unbinding is connected to each Stable location, and vice-versa.
Investigators at attached location are considered to be engaged with each Miasma enemy during the enemy phase.
78241.backText:
Miasma. Unbinding.
Cradle of Baalshandor is connected to each location with a horror on it, and vice-versa.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: place 1 doom on this location.

78242.name: Greyson’s Loyalists
78242.text:
[fast] If you control Agent Greyson: Move Greyson’s Loyalists to an adjacent location.
[reaction] At the end of the round, if it is not act 1, exile Agent Greyson: Flip this card and resolve its story text.
Forced – At the end of the round: Greyson’s Loyalists deals 2 damage to each enemy at their location.
78242.backText: Remember that “you know of the binding”. You may defeat any Miasma enemy. You may place 1 horror on any location. Remove this card from the game.
78242.backFlavor:
Greyson motions you aside, and shoves a binder full of papers into your hands. “Contingency plan, sent from on high. I can’t make heads or tails of it - but you can. You got one shot at this. Understood?”
Before you can respond, Greyson turns to her assembled agents with grim-faced determination.
“It’s the end of the world. You’re gonna die tonight. Same as everybody else. But there’s two differences between you and the rest of the world.
“One - they didn’t sign up for this.
Two - You got a chance to stop it. To save everyone you ever gave a damn about.
So what do you say, ladies? Who else feels like spitting in the face of death tonight?”

78243.name: Messenger of the Flame
78243.text:
Forced – At the start of the enemy phase, if Feed the Flame is at a Miasma location without horror: Defeat that location. Otherwise, move Feed the Flame once towards the nearest Miasma location without horror.
[fast] If it is not act 1, the investigators spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Out of desperation, you seek a bargain with Cthugha. Flip this card and resolve its story text.
78243.backText: Remember that “you know of the binding”. Remember that “your body belongs to Cthugha”. Exile each copy of Strength of Flesh. Choose up to 2 locations. Flip any Miasma locations chosen this way. Place a horror on the chosen locations. Flip this card back over and place a horror on it.
78243.backFlavor:
The terrifying messenger offers a massive palm. Nervously, you place your hand on his own. Immediately, you are wracked with pain, as fire burns up the sides of your arm and around your neck. It burns away, leaving a deep black charring snaking down your limb. Your arm trails smoke that leads back to the Messenger. The knowledge burns in your mind - sigils and incantations to renew the bindings.
The deal is struck. You are kindling, waiting to be used.

78244.name: Messenger of the King
78244.text:
Forced – At the start of the enemy phase, if Messenger of the King is at a Miasma location without horror: Defeat that location. Otherwise, move Messenger of the King once towards the nearest Miasma location without horror.
[fast] If it is not act 1, the investigators spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Out of desperation, you seek a bargain with the King. Flip this card and resolve its story text.
78244.backText: Remember that “you know of the binding”. Remember that “you owe Hastur your life”. Exile each copy of Unbreakable Will. Choose up to 2 locations. Flip any Miasma locations chosen this way. Place a horror on the chosen locations. Remove this card from the game.
78244.backFlavor:
You kneel before the enigmatic yellow Messenger. It lowers its towering mask to meet your gaze, then unfurls a lengthy scroll. With a wrinkled grey talon, it draws a ragged line across the bottom of the scroll, then beckons you to sign. Though the scroll is in a language you have never seen, you comprehend that your very existence is the price that is demanded. You sign without hesitation. The knowledge floods your mind - sigils and incantations to renew the bindings.
You must complete your task, then await the King’s mercy.

78245.name: Baalshandor
78245.flavor:
I am the progenitor.
All life bows to me.
Your efforts are meaningless.

78246.name: Flesh Unbound
78246.text:
Cannot be canceled or discarded.
Revelation – Attach to the location recorded in your Campaign Log as the Site of Unbinding.
Investigators at attached location are considered to be engaged with each Miasma enemy during the enemy phase.

78247.name: Fear the Writhing Life
78247.text:
Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Fear the Writhing Life into play in your threat area.
Forced – After your location flips: Take 2 damage.
[reaction] After you defeat a Miasma enemy: Discard Fear the Writhing Life.

78248.name: Growing Destruction
78248.text:
Revelation – Flip the nearest non-Rallied location to its enemy side. Then, choose one:
– Test [willpower] (X). X is that location’s shroud value.
– Test [combat] (X). X is that enemy’s fight value.
If you fail either test, that enemy attacks you, regardless of location.

78249.name: One of Many
78249.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Forced – When One of Many’s location would flip: Cancel the flip of that location, remove all tokens from that location, and deal 1 horror to each investigator at that location.
[reaction] After you defeat One of Many: Flip its location and resolve any story text.

78250.name: Agency Troubleshooter
78250.text: Hunter. Retaliate. After attacking during the enemy phase, disengage this enemy and move one location away from the nearest Safe location.

78251.name: Jury-Rigged Incendiary
78251.text: Attach to your location. Before an investigator leaves, discard this and deal 3 damage to every investigator and enemy here. [action]: Test agility (3); on success discard this. After revealing a token, you may end your turn to ignore that token and automatically succeed.

78252.name: Panicked Agent
78252.text: Alert. After making an attack of opportunity, deal 1 damage to every investigator at this location, then automatically evade this enemy.

78253.name: Suppressing Fire
78253.text: Revelation: Test agility (4). On failure, move one location away from the nearest Safe location. If you fail by 2 or more, take 2 damage.

78254.name: Fire Vampire
78254.text:
Prey – Fewest assets controlled.
Forced – When Fire Vampire attacks you during the enemy phase: Discard an asset you control.
Victory 1.

78255.name: The Living Flame
78255.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Discard the highest cost asset you control. You may place 1 doom on that asset to cancel this effect. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

78256.name: Idle Hands
78256.text: Put this in your threat area. During your turn, take 2 damage and discard this as a free ability to gain 1 action. At the end of your turn, take 1 horror.

78257.name: Twisted Supplicant
78257.text: Hunter. Prey: most Terror treacheries. Attacks deal +1 damage and +1 horror if you have a Terror treachery in your threat area.

78258.name: Under Your Skin
78258.text: Put this in your threat area. After you successfully investigate or fight, discard 1 random card from hand. [action][action]: Discard this.

78259.name: Bad News
78259.text: Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, discard each non-weakness event in your hand. If you failed and no events were discarded this way, Bad News gains surge.
78259.flavor: The headlines alone are enough to make you retch.

78260.name: Doyle Jeffries
78260.text:
Hunter. Alert.
Forced – When an investigator at Doyle Jeffries’ location or a connecting location plays an event: Ready Doyle Jeffries. If he is engaged with an investigator, he makes an immediate attack.
Victory 1.

78261.name: Bankrupture
78261.text: Revelation – You may spend any number of resources. Test [agility] (X), where X is 1 greater than the number of resources in your pool. Reduce the difficulty of this test by the number of resources you spent. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

78262.name: The Vice President
78262.text:
Hunter.
The Vice President gets + 1[per_investigator] damage and + 1[per_investigator] horror.
Forced – When The Vice President attacks: each investigator at its location may spend any number of resources. Reduce the damage and/or horror of this attack by the number of resources spent.
Victory 1.

78263.name: Worked To The Bone
78263.text:
Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Worked To The Bone into play in your threat area.
Forced – After you commit 1 or more skill cards to a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or discard a card at random.
[free] If you have no skill cards in hand: Discard Worked To The Bone.

78264.name: The Thing in the Water
78264.text:
Massive. Hunter.
As an additional cost to fight or evade The Thing in the Water, you must commit all eligible skill cards from your hand.
Victory 1.
78264.flavor: It has grown fat on the muscle of the skilled.

78265.name: Damaged Goods
78265.text:
Revelation – Attach to a non-permanent asset you control. If you control no non-permanent assets, this card gains surge.
[action]: Take 2 damage and discard Damaged Goods.
Forced – After you play an asset: Discard attached asset. Attach Damaged Goods to the played asset.

78266.name: The Loving Couple
78266.text:
Hunter.
The Loving Couple gets +1 health for each non-permanent asset controlled by an investigator at its location.
Victory 1.
78266.flavor: Their love transcends the material and the moral.

78267.name: Bone Dry
78267.text:
Revelation – Put Bone Dry into play in your threat area with 3 resources on it. If there are no resources on Bone Dry, discard it.
Forced – When you would succeed by 2 or more at a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or fail by 1 instead. Remove 1 resource from Bone Dry.

78268.name: Hibbs
78268.text:
Hunter. Retaliate. Alert.
Forced – After you successfully fight or evade Hibbs by 2 or more: You must either place 1 doom on Hibbs or it attacks you.
Victory 1.
78268.flavor: He may have had it coming, but you let this happen.

78269.name: Broken Trust
78269.text:
Revelation – Attach to an Ally asset you control. If you control no Ally assets, Broken Trust gains surge.
Treat attached asset’s text box as if it were blank.
[action] Spend 1 resource, plus 1 additional resource for each damage and/or horror on attached asset: Discard Broken Trust.

78270.name: Ma Matheson
78270.text:
Hunter.
Forced – After Ma Matheson attacks, if any amount of damage and/or horror was assigned to an Ally asset: Exile that asset.
Victory 1.

78271.name: Whispers of Power
78271.text:
Revelation – Attach to the highest cost non-Ally asset you control.
As an additional cost to trigger an ability on the attached card, take 1 horror.
Attached card gains “[action]: Return this asset to your hand and discard all attached copies of Whispers of Power.”

78272.name: Miriam Beecher
78272.text:
Hunter.
Miriam Beecher deals X total damage and/or horror divided as evenly as possible, where X is the cost of the highest cost non-Ally asset controlled by an investigator at her location.
Victory 1.
78272.flavor: She has become more dangerous than anything she collected.

78273.name: You Know Too Much
78273.text:
Revelation – Put this card into play in your threat area.
Forced – At the end of your turn: Take X horror, where X is 4 fewer than the number of cards in your hand. Then, discard You Know Too Much.
78273.flavor: Your mind is not your own.

78274.name: Henry Armitage
78274.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Henry Armitage gets +1 damage and +1 horror while engaged with an investigator with 5 or more cards in their hand.
Forced – After an investigator at Henry Armitage’s location draws a card: Henry Armitage engages and attacks that investigator.
Victory 1.
78274.flavor: Even the strongest wills bow to the Bearer of Plagues.

78275.name: Arkham Advertiser
78275.text: At the start of your turn here, reveal an event from your hand or discard. Take X damage and/or horror in total, where X is its cost. If it costs 0, remove it from the game.
78275.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78276.name: Bank of Arkham
78276.text: At the start of your turn here, lose half your resources, rounded up.
78276.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78277.name: General Store
78277.text: At the start of your turn here, discard an asset you control; two if you control 5 or more.
78277.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78278.name: Hibbs Roadhouse
78278.text: At the start of your turn here, choose your highest skill and reduce it to 1 for the rest of the phase.
78278.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78279.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78279.text: At the start of your turn here, take damage or horror equal to the total health or sanity of your highest-cost Ally. You cannot choose a zero value.
78279.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78280.name: Orne Library
78280.text: At the start of your turn here, discard down to 3 cards in hand.
78280.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78281.name: River Docks
78281.text: At the start of your turn here, reveal a skill from your hand. Discard it or take horror equal to its icons.
78281.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78282.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78282.text: At the start of your turn here, draw an encounter card or discard your highest-cost non-Ally asset.
78282.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78283.name: Grinning Victim
78283.text: Hunter. After engaging you, lose an action. If you cannot, it attacks you.

78284.name: Driving Urge
78284.text: Revelation: Test willpower (4). On failure, move one location toward the nearest Miasma location. If you fail by 2 or more, take 2 horror.

78285.name: Not Yourself
78285.text: Put this in your threat area. Each time you move, lose 1 resource. At turn end, test willpower (3); on success discard this. At a Miasma location you may take 1 horror to automatically succeed.

78286.name: Call of the Grave
78286.text:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation – Choose an investigator with a copy of Strength of Flesh in their play area, if able. That investigator takes 1 horror for each damage on their copy of Strength of Flesh. Then, heal all damage from their copy of Strength of Flesh.
78286.flavor: The dead will take their own, in time…

78287.name: Mounting Injuries
78287.text:
Surge. Peril.
Revelation – Choose an investigator with a copy of Unbreakable Will in their play area, if able. That investigator takes 1 damage for each horror on their copy of Unbreakable Will. Then, heal all horror from their copy of Unbreakable Will.
78287.flavor: You can't keep this up forever…

78288.name: Mindless Thrall
78288.text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest Miasma location). At the end of the enemy phase, if at a Miasma location, place 1 doom on this enemy.

78289.name: Worshipful Thrall
78289.text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest Miasma location). After the hunter movement step, if at a Miasma location, search the encounter deck and discard for a Mindless Thrall and spawn it here. Victory 1.

78290.name: Heed the Call
78290.text: Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you have heeded the call, you must reveal an additional token for this check. For each point you fail by, you must either move one location towards an Unbinding location, or resolve a forced effect on a revealed Miasma location in play as if you had started your turn at that location.

78291.name: Ire of the Unbound
78291.text:
Revelation – Put Ire of the Unbound into your threat area.
Forced – After you enter or start your turn at a location with damage or horror on it: Move one damage or horror from that location onto a card you control.
Forced –At the end of your turn, if you did not deal damage or gain clues, discard Ire of the Unbound.

78292.name: Tenuous Allies
78292.text: Attached card does not take up any slots, and gains: “Forced – When the game ends or this card would leave play: Remove this card and Tenuous Allies from the game.”

78020b.name: Abhorrent Pustule
78020b.text: Massive. Hunter. After taking 2 or more damage from one source, return a clue from the nearest location without Survivors or Ruins to the pool. Victory 2.

78054b.name: Back for More
78054b.text:
Revelation – Replace the act and agenda decks with Back for More. Spawn the set-aside First Among Many at the Grand Hall.
Forced – When doom is placed on any card: Either resolve the hunter keyword on First Among Many, or resolve the hunter keyword on each Re-Animated enemy in play.

78070b.name: Virgil
78070b.text:
Spawn – Servant’s Entry.
Hunter. Cannot be defeated.
78070b.flavor: “It does not matter how poor of condition a subject was in when retrieved. Recency of death is the sole defining factor in successful reagent application.”

78071b.name: Ichabod
78071b.text:
Spawn – Grand Hall.
Hunter. Alert. Retaliate. Cannot be defeated.
Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from Ichabod.
78071b.flavor: “Once properly motivated, subjects can be guided and even follow simple commands. That proper motivation requires removal of the head is admittedly a flaw.”

78186b.name: Pickman’s Memory
78186b.text:
Revelation – Place Pickman’s Memory in the victory display, and attach each asset in the victory display to it. Spawn the set-aside Dr. Elias Pickman enemy at Pickman’s Memory.
Each enemy and investigator in the victory display is considered to be at Pickman’s Memory.
Victory 1.
78186b.flavor: A final moment, trapped in time.

78222b.name: Mouth of Baalshandor
78222b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Exile the event in your hand with the highest experience cost.

78223b.name: Chest of Baalshandor
78223b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Lose all your resources.

78224b.name: Claws of Baalshandor
78224b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Choose a non-permanent asset you control. Discard each asset in your play area and hand with the same resource cost as the chosen asset.

78225b.name: Belly of Baalshandor
78225b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: You automatically fail the next test you take this phase.

78226b.name: Heart of Baalshandor
78226b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Move damage from this location onto a single Ally asset you control equal to that asset’s remaining health.

78227b.name: Brain of Baalshandor
78227b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Choose and discard all but 2 cards from your hand.

78228b.name: Arms of Baalshandor
78228b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Discard each skill card in your hand.

78229b.name: Eye of Baalshandor
78229b.text: Forced – After you start your turn at this location: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

78241b.name: Cradle of Baalshandor
78241b.text:
Cradle of Baalshandor is connected to each location with a horror on it, and vice-versa.
Forced – After you start your turn at this location: place 1 doom on this location.
